# t7.1 — Opt-in, policy-checked POM capability

## Summary

Implemented a separate, default-deny POM capability for scenario runtimes. It exposes only fixed read-only dashboard observations through a typed `invoke()` facade; it does not expose a Playwright `Page`, `BrowserContext`, POManager, locator, or full Cucumber World. Enabling it requires both agentic and POM-specific opt-in plus an explicit action allowlist.

## Findings and Limitations

- The capability is available only to a custom, explicitly configured runtime; the repository's existing runtime factory remains an unconfigured placeholder.
- Only read-only dashboard observations are supported. No mutation, locator construction, arbitrary Playwright API, or autonomous test-result authority was added.
- Browser-backed legacy login/dashboard journeys remain unverified. The capability addition does not close the separate CRITICAL evidence gap in `t7-teamlead.md`.
- Existing t4 TLS/logging and memory/telemetry findings were not changed by this task.
- Pre-existing worktree changes to `artifacts/project-profile.yaml`, `board.md`, and t7 teamlead artifacts were left untouched.
